plan.notes: Transcribed from the official College of Marin Career Education Catalog (cte.marin.edu, Academic Year 2022-2023), Graphic Design / Multimedia Studies program page. PROGRAM OFFERINGS lists 'Certificate of Achievement, Multimedia Studies - Graphic Design Track (24.5 units)'. FALL CORE CLASSES sum to 12.5 (MMST 101 0.5, MMST 110 3, GDES112/MMST112 3, GDES120/MMST120 3, GDES132/MMST132 3) and SPRING CORE CLASSES sum to 12.0 (MMST 111 3, GDES115/MMST115 3, GDES122/MMST122 3, GDES200/MMST200 3); 12.5 + 12.0 = 24.5, matching the certificate total exactly. Cross-listed courses are encoded under their MMST number with the GDES equivalent noted. The standalone Graphic Design certificate (18 units) has no published term sequence and the two 60-unit AS options include unsequenced general education; all are NOT collected (honest negative). Classes online and at IVC; scheduling subject to change.
